newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Sao Paulo launches energy selloff internet page. [CORRECTED 15:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Sao Paulo launches energy selloff internet page. [CORRECTED 15:00 GMT]

text.p: The Brazilian state of Sao Paulo said it has launched an internet home-page in Portuguese providing financial data on its electrical utilities and news about the privatization of its power sector.
The page, which will soon have an English version, is avaliable at the following address http://eu.ansp.br/(tilde)energia.
(Corrects the above internet address to insert the character "tilde" before the word "energia").
Investors can also contact the state's energy office by e-mail through energia@eu.ansp.br.
